resources.string: Shizuku channel, development-level permissions, system special access and AI automation control.
Real channel state; the grant dialog only appears when you ask for it.
WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS, DUMP, READ_LOGS, CHANGE_CONFIGURATION — grant and revoke per item.
Modify system settings, usage access, DND, exact alarms, all files and more.
Off by default; writes have their own switch; one assistant must be chosen.

Boundary: this page only mirrors real system replies. Shizuku is a shell-level channel — it does not root the device, cannot grant system-signature-only privileges, and cannot read other apps\' private directories.
System / signature only — cannot be obtained with a normal grant
Accessibility, notification listeners and similar are bound by the system settings page. They are never switched on silently here.
Command ran but the requested permission state did not take effect
Nothing is requested until you press this. Shizuku will show its own confirmation.
Shizuku works at shell level only. It does not root the device and cannot turn this app into a system-signed app — a normal user grant never becomes system privileges.
These can only be granted through Shizuku (adb shell pm grant). The checkboxes are just a selection for the batch buttons below.
Pick the items to act on. Each item reports its own real result afterwards.
Copied only when you tap. The package name is this build\'s actual value (%1$s).
No command available on this device
These are granted on the system\'s own settings pages. Coming back to this page re-reads the real state; a declared permission is not a granted one.
Allow AI to operate this device
Off by default. Turning it off cancels the current automation session immediately; permissions are never inherited from other workspaces.
A separate switch, off by default. It only affects commands that change the device.
Choose one assistant explicitly. If none is chosen, no assistant gets access.
The chosen assistant no longer exists — pick one again
Choose an assistant first, then turn this on
Can do: read and change system settings, diagnostics, and the Shizuku commands granted above. Shell level only — not highest privilege, and it cannot read other apps\' private directories.
Runs through the AI tool once automation is on and WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS is granted; this page only shows state.
Reads screen structure, performance and permission state for the AI. It changes nothing.
Only the development-level permissions granted above are offered as shell commands; anything else is refused.
